photos.c: Right: Australia's Shirley Strickland (third from left) wins the British Empire vs U.S.A. 80m hurdles at White City in August 1952. Left to right: P.Seaborne (G.B.), Jean Desforges (G.B.), who later married Ron Pickering, Strickland, E.Maskell (S.A.) and C.Denowski (U.S.A.)
